name: ucx
description: Unified Communication X (UCX) is an optimized communication framework for high-bandwidth and low-latency networks.

cuda.description: Enable CUDA support. Validated against the installed toolkit (>= 12.2, cuda.h, cuda_runtime.h, nvml.h, libcuda, libcudart, libnvidia-ml).

knem.description: Enable KNEM support using the header-only knem port.

valgrind.description: Enable Valgrind client-request annotations using the header-only valgrind port.

xpmem.description: Enable XPMEM support using the xpmem port.
